text_block_list.name: Vendor Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Ah... We were moving in the new training machines,
but... the dolly broke.
Even a custom-made dolly was no match for the weight, huh...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, I can help.

text_block_list.name: Vendor Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for carrying it.
I really appreciate your help!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No. Are we setting up next?
I'll help out with that too.

text_block_list.name: Vendor Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, no, I'd feel bad!
Besides, aren't you busy—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
By the way, this new feature described in the manual... is quite fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I want to give this a try... Come on, let's get it ready for use as quickly as possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Duramente helped adjust the machine until the very end, and had to skip that day's training.
